Question Choices: Fill: in the blank: 70 tens = ____ hundreds
Hints: Moving a count to the next smaller place unit multiplies it by 10; moving to the next larger divides by 10.
Solution: Ten tens make one hundred. Divide the count by 10: 70 tens = 7 hundreds. Both have value 700.

Question Choices: Fill: in the blank: 7 thousands = ____ hundreds
Hints: Moving a count to the next smaller place unit multiplies it by 10; moving to the next larger divides by 10.
Solution: One thousand equals 10 hundreds. Multiply 7 x 10 = 70, so 7 thousands = 70 hundreds.

Question Choices: Fill: in the blank 3600  =  3 thousands + ___ hundreds
Hints: Subtract the known place-value amounts from the total, then divide by the value of the missing unit.
Solution: Three thousands have value 3000. Subtract 3600 - 3000 = 600, which is 6 hundreds.

Question Choices: Fill: in the blank 6800 = 5 thousands + ____ hundreds
Hints: Subtract the known place-value amounts from the total, then divide by the value of the missing unit.
Solution: Five thousands have value 5000. Subtract 6800 - 5000 = 1800. Divide 1800 by 100 to get 18 hundreds.

Question Choices: Fill: in the blank: 40 hundreds = ____ thousands
Hints: Moving a count to the next smaller place unit multiplies it by 10; moving to the next larger divides by 10.
Solution: Ten hundreds make one thousand. Divide 40 by 10: 40 hundreds = 4 thousands.

Question Choices: Fill: in the blank: 8 hundreds = ___ tens
Hints: Moving a count to the next smaller place unit multiplies it by 10; moving to the next larger divides by 10.
Solution: One hundred equals 10 tens. Multiply 8 x 10 = 80, so 8 hundreds = 80 tens.

Question Choices: Select which of the following is equivalent to 5 thousands + 12 hundreds: ~~6-thousands+2-hundreds | 5-thousands+2-hundreds | 6-thousands+12-hundreds~~
Hints: Multiply each count by its unit value, add the values, then regroup as requested.
Solution: Twelve hundreds equal 1 thousand and 2 hundreds. Add the extra thousand to the original 5: 6 thousands + 2 hundreds = 6200.

Question Choices: Select which of the following is equivalent to 7 thousand + 5 hundred: ~~6-thousands+15-hundreds | 6-thousands+25-hundreds | 8-thousands+15-hundreds~~
Hints: Subtract the known place-value amounts from the total, then divide by the value of the missing unit.
Solution: Exchange one of the 7 thousands for 10 hundreds: 7 thousands + 5 hundreds = 6 thousands + 15 hundreds. Both total 7500.
